reviews.author: Hải Đăng Trần
reviews.text:
This buffet restaurant is located near the musical fountain show on Sentosa Island.
The food selection is extremely poor, with barely around a dozen dishes, and the taste is absolutely terrible. I strongly advise against eating here—honestly, grabbing instant noodles at 7-Eleven would be way better. The service was also very disappointing; they wouldn't even let customers use a power outlet to charge their phones.

reviews.author: Avik Banerjee
reviews.text: Booked the Indian Thali dinner combo along with our Wings of Time tickets at Good Old Days (Siloso Beach). The thali was very filling and flavorful, featuring savory chicken curry, dal, aloo matar, spiced rice, naan, papadum, and a samosa. It also came with juice and ice cream to finish. Super convenient location right by the show venue—definitely worth grabbing as a combo package!

reviews.author: Caleb Look
reviews.text:
$9.80 for grilled chicken chop and $2.50 for iced coffee at Sentosa - pretty value for money considering this is Sentosa. Quality of food and drink was good. Comfortable, air-conditioned environment.

Cutlery and condiments are neatly displayed in a separate section.

reviews.author: Deborah Corleto
reviews.text: Avoid this place 🚨🔔 staff is not polite. Food  is not worth the experience.  There are huge advertisements of iced tea and ice coffee for affordable price. You enter to order and they are not available at the ordering. In my case, I went out to the coffe shop outside to get some iced coffee. When I entered they told “NOT ALLWED TO BRING IN BEVERAGES FROM OUTSIDE” which I replied “ok what should i do? “ they asked me to not drink it and leave it on the side. The manner they told was not polite but anyways I didn’t want more uncomfortable situations. I indicated also, that if the drinks are not allowed that at least they should have what they are promoting everywhere outside. They replied that that a different stand to order there. Note that one “coffee” stand was empty with no staff  (see video). So the real next level impolite situation was when I was spiced up with the food and I was nearly breathing because I was coughing of the spiced food, I has available water but I needed something to calm down the spice which my iced latte was soothing option to ease the spice pain. Which I decided to get ONE sip of the drink. The same senior staff came to ask me no to drink it, again ima DEROGATORY tone, I explained that I  needed tho drink something “ milky” to calm down. It was so uncomfortable, I know there are rules but that is not a way for treating the customers. To comment further more on the impolite mannerisms of the staff, some young girls were looking for the bathroom and then from a distance she was screaming to go outside but in a derogatory way.  I don’t think these are the standards of Singapore customer service is just this place that need to urgently improve.

reviews.author: CK C
reviews.text: This Halal food court offers Malay-Indian rice, Chinese noodles, Western food and Chicken Rice. Food quality and taste were poor but portion was generous and was probably the cheapest option (most mains at $9.80) along Siloso beach. Many items, including hot drinks, were not available even by 11.20am. Staff were not helpful when approached and insisted that everything is automatic and just check the ordering kiosk. Taps were impossible for washing both hands.

reviews.author: Gopi Bala
reviews.text:
There is always a long queue at this stall, and it's been a while since I last ate their wanton mee.

When it came to my turn at about 1.30pm, there was no char siew left, and so I opted for the prawn dumpling noodles.

I must say the noodles were thumbs up al dente and the chilli was great as was the various ingredients in the plate of noodles.

The shrimp wantons also really succulent and delicious, and the tasty soup was piping hot until the last drop.

They are closed on Monday, Thursday and Friday.

What would have made the meal even more stellar was to have cruncy bits of fried pork lard in the noodles.

reviews.author: Justin Tan
reviews.text: April 2025: I had just finished a 10 km hike and was craving for wantan noodles.  There were 15 people waiting ahead of me even though I came at 1115 hrs. When it was my turn, I ordered the char siew wantan noodle $5 and a bowl of dumpling soup for $5. I asked for 1 piece of chicken feet and paid an extra $1.50. Maybe I was polite, and the owners gave me an extra piece. The soup was delicious,  full of anchovy flavours.  The dumplings have pieces of prawns in them. The char siew was moist, but I wished that they could have been fattier. The wantans were delicious.  The noodles were springy but had a bicarbonate soda taste, which disappeared when mixed with the chilli sauce. This is certainly a favourite stall of mine, even though I don't like the food centre, a bit warm and small. It closes on Monday,  Thursday, and Friday. There's a bubble tea stall almost close to it, and the drinks were refreshing and cheap.

reviews.author: Darren Tan
reviews.text: Very nice old school wanton noodles.. wanton filling is good and nice. Noodles is chewy and well cooked.. added 2 dumplings and it come with small prawn and the overall taste just nice.. even soup is well cooked. Must try ..expect a wait for good food though..

reviews.author: James ZGQing
reviews.text: Highly recommended by friends and I’m totally satisfied for my first try. Distinctive Cantonese flavour, generous servings and most importantly, hand made Wanton and Shrimp dumplings is heavenly made! Spoke to the owner and he is very courteous and pleasant. Can’t give full marks for atmosphere as it’s a typical hawker centre. Do note the limited opening days and timings if u wish to try! Will certainly return for more!

reviews.author: Mal Osi
reviews.text:
True local gem. This small stand, run daily by a humble and kind elderly couple, serves up some of the best wanton noodles in the area. Open every day, the queue forms quickly, so be prepared to wait. But the wait is absolutely worth it.

The wanton mee is simple, traditional, and full of flavor — the noodles springy, the char siew tender, and the wantons perfectly seasoned. It’s the kind of comforting, nostalgic plate that keeps you coming back. If you’re in the neighbourhood, don’t miss it. A must-try.

places.name: Bar Bar Black Sheep @ Cherry Ave

reviews.author: Mark Azzopardi
reviews.text:
Really cool venue. Even thought it’s near the main road it’s blocked off by a garden wall. The staff are awesome - fast and friendly!! Options for food are great! They do curries, Thai and pizza. 3 different menus to choose from.

A really nice place to come with friends with kids. Highly recommend.

Recommend reservation if on busy night like a Friday, or if coming with a large group.

reviews.author: Ivan Teh
reviews.text:
Naan (SGD $9) @ Bar Bar Black Sheep.
.
With 3 independent kitchens, including a North Indian focused kitchen, this watering hole is a relaxed night-time dining spot.
.
Their rendition is soft fluffy chewy in texture, tearing apart easily. While the plain version exudes smoky bready sweet savoury flavour, the garlic version studded with minced garlic and fresh coriander exudes smoky bready savoury vegetal bitter herbal spice flavour.
.
.
.
Palak Paneer (SGD $15) @ Bar Bar Black Sheep.
.
This casual gastrobar struggled to find its footing over the last few years, and it appears things have stabilized.
.
Their rendition has a vibrant green hue, the puréed spinach curry being thick and creamy while the paneer cottage cheese cubes are tender and soft.
.
Generously laced with cream, this carries vegetal sweet savoury herbal spice milky sour cheesy flavour.

reviews.author: Jeff Leong
reviews.text:
This is a nice, casual neighbourhood gastropub for residents staying in Bukit Timah Road area. It is equally well patronised by diners from further away. Its open-air premises has a rustic atmosphere, with dining tables and high tables. Adults and children are welcomed here.

A variety of cuisines is offered to accompany beers, homemade lemonade and drinks. As credit cards of customers are held by the operator, we felt more comfortable to pay as we ordered to avoid unnecessary hassle of disputed charges.

reviews.author: Howard
reviews.text:
Decent option for casual drinks and it has a reasonable range of tap beers. The seating is all covered but it's open plan and semi-outdoors (ie, no walls). That's ok though because the location is set back from the main road so it doesn't get too much traffic noise and ends up with a nice breeze.
The food is from a separate (but connected) Indian kitchen and is good but it's a little annoying you can't just order it all at once with the drinks.
Fun, relaxed place for a beer.

reviews.author: Raphael
reviews.text: (The Indian chef who made this great food is gone and so is the quality, likely same with Thai - very sad)) Can’t go wrong any night of the week. Perfect Indian fare, burgers for kids, and authentic Thai... all of it with perfect pint of Carlsberg or whatever beer you have in mind including some choice IPAs.

reviews.author: munkymandee
reviews.text:
Decided to come here on a whim after a quick look at google reviews. Very happy to say it exceeded our expectations. Service was very friendly, every single person was so polite. Upon being seated we were given a basket of freshly toasted baguette with butter, and water. The bread was so good!

There were four of us but two were small eaters so we ordered three 3-course sets to share. For $32 you get a starter, main, and dessert.

For starters we got the mesclun salad, mushroom soup and truffle fries. Everything was so well seasoned and fresh. Like, these are simple starters but we were already impressed by these! For the mains, we had the shrimp linguine, seafood soup and pork belly. Everything was generously portioned. Pasta was perfectly al dente. Soup was so rich and full of seafood. Porkbelly was crispy outside and tender inside. It paired very well with the apples and sauce. The mash was so creamy and good.

We were quite blown away by the quality of food. We even got a second basket of bread to mop up all the sauces.

For dessert we tried the belgian chocolate ice cream and peach sorbet. Both were good. Quite glad they gave small scoops because by then we were stufffffed.

They also had a 10% off promo going, so in total our 3 sets cost $86.40 after the discount. Totally value for money. I would recommend this place to everyone. It was quite sad to see that we were the only table on a friday night. Please support them!!!!!

reviews.author: Princess Mania
reviews.text:
Nice cozy atmosphere with friendly and attentive staff; always checking in on us and getting feedback about their food. Even the chef behind the glass kitchen panel would steal glances at us and asking us non-verbally about their food. The meal also came with complimentary French bread and butter. The restaurant offers extra to replenish.
Tried the pan fried pork belly - tasty, crispy and succulent without being overly rich to the palate. Enjoy my truffle fries which came with truffle shavings and Parmesan shavings.  Portion was good. Enjoyed my salted caramel ice-cream. On the whole, it was a good and enjoyable meal.
No service charge but has GST. However, GST is also being absorbed by the restuarant. There is a tipping box. Do tip them!

reviews.author: Jewel
reviews.text:
The staff were so friendly and service was great. They were attentive and polite. They served bread which had a crispy crust & soft fluffy interior with generous servings of salted butter. I really enjoyed it.

We ordered the Garden Mesclun Salad, Duck Confit Leg, and Pork Belly with Freshly Baked Madeleines (comes with ice cream).

The salad was refreshing. duck confit was well seasoned and meat was extremely tender, great when paired with the mash potatoes which was creamy and smooth. The pork belly was cooked to perfection, fats melt in the mouth, crispy exterior, paired great with the cooked apples which cut through the greasiness of the fat.

Lastly really enjoyed the fresh madeleines, which were crispy on the edges, light lemon fragrance and beautiful texture. The warm madeleines contrasts the cold ice cream, simply delicious.

I was glad that my grandma enjoyed the food, her first time trying french cuisine. Beautiful interior, meaningful mission, and beautiful artworks available for purchase.

reviews.author: Ben Star
reviews.text:
🌟 Finally Made It! A Delightful French Set-Meal Experience🌟
I finally had the chance to dine at [Breakthrough Art & Crafts Café]! Interestingly, my first two attempts were unsuccessful. On my first visit, I arrived too late and the café had already closed. On my second attempt, I had not made a reservation, and the café was packed with diners. We had no choice but to head to a nearby hawker centre instead.
This time, our group of more than 40 people made a reservation in advance and gathered here for a meal. Having seen so many five-star reviews, I was looking forward to finally experiencing the café for myself—and I am happy to say that it did not disappoint!
Upon entering, we were greeted by soft, soothing music that created a relaxing atmosphere. The interior was tastefully arranged and spotlessly tidy, while the staff were warm, welcoming and attentive. Their thoughtful hospitality made us feel right at home. The café offers both an air-conditioned indoor dining area and an open-air seating area with natural ventilation, catering to different preferences.
🍽️ The Food Experience
I ordered the 【Pan-Fried Pork Belly Set】, accompanied by a starter of Chinese-Style Egg Omelette. My companion chose the 【Pan-Fried Barramundi Set】, with a starter of Creamy Mushroom Soup.
🥓 【Pan-Fried Pork Belly】
The pork belly was cooked to perfection—tender and juicy, never dry or tough. Its skin was wonderfully crispy, while the meat was rich in flavour without being overly greasy. It was so tender that it practically melted in the mouth! Paired with smooth, creamy mashed potatoes, the combination was simply delicious.
🐟 【Pan-Fried Barramundi】
My companion’s barramundi was equally impressive. Beautifully pan-fried and fragrant, the fish was served with baby potatoes, vegetables and a pleasantly tangy sauce. The refreshing flavours complemented the fish wonderfully, making the dish appetising and enjoyable without any unpleasant fishy taste.
🍄 【Creamy Mushroom Soup with Crispy Toast】
The mushroom soup was rich, creamy and full of flavour. Paired with crispy toasted bread that could be replenished without extra charge, it made a simple yet satisfying combination. The contrast between the velvety soup and crunchy toast was delightful, and my companion thoroughly enjoyed it!
✨ 【Overall Verdict: Excellent Value for Money!】
Overall, the French-style set meals were delicious, reasonably priced and certainly worth the money.
Another highlight was the efficient service.
Despite our large group of more than 40 diners, the food arrived smoothly and without undue delays, thanks to our advance reservation. The staff remained friendly, attentive and well organised throughout our visit, allowing everyone to relax and enjoy the gathering.
This visit was well worth the wait, and the café has left us with a very positive impression & experience!
On our next visit, I would love to explore more dishes from the à la carte menu.
I would also be happy to recommend [Breakthrough Art & Crafts Café] to friends looking for a comfortable dining atmosphere, warm hospitality, tasty food and good value for money.
A thoroughly enjoyable dining experience—one worth sharing and definitely worth revisiting! ❤️

reviews.author: cinnamonlane cinnamonlane
reviews.text: The food is great! The cooking style is perfect and the ingredients taste amazing , they even provide free flow bread. The service here is great as the servers are very dedicated! The atmosphere is a perfect warm comforting environment. This is a great place to check out if you want to have a nice multi course French authentic cuisine!!!

reviews.author: Musthafa Kaamal Mohammad
reviews.text:
Had a very pleasant meal here with my mom. The food was delicious and very nicely presented, and everything looked fresh and well prepared. The restaurant was clean, neat and had a really comfortable atmosphere.
The staff were very friendly and welcoming, especially the tall Indian manager who attended to us. He was extremely kind, polite and made us feel very welcome throughout our visit.
Overall, we had a wonderful dining experience and really enjoyed our time here. Good food, great service and a lovely atmosphere. Definitely a place I would happily visit again! 👍

reviews.author: Amir M
reviews.text: Stopped by Marrybrown to take away a meal and was really impressed by the service. A special shoutout to Al Ajamal, who went above and beyond to make sure our order was accurate and served quickly. His friendly attitude and professionalism truly made our visit pleasant. Thank you, Al Ajamal and the whole team

reviews.author: Shi Leng Teo
reviews.text: 2 piece meal original dine-in. Served quickly after ordering. Chicken was fresh, crispy and tender. Bread was meh but the coleslaw and mash potato were good and completed the meal. Restaurant was clean.

reviews.author: sher
reviews.text: good service, but food is super mediocre and can be improved. $9.9 for this… no fries and the sides given are very small portion.

reviews.author: Miss Pea
reviews.text: Love marrybrown. Nolstagia. Wide menu options. Cute toy collections. Very tasty chicken and rice.
